title: Using Instruction-Tuned Large Language Models to Identify Indicators of Vulnerability in Police Incident Narratives

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual generation of police narratives by systematically altering sex descriptors (female, male, unknown) and evaluating the impact on the model's vulnerability classifications using generalized linear mixed-effects models (GLMMs) and average marginal effects.

Counterfactual generation of police narratives by systematically altering race descriptors (Black, White, Hispanic, Asian, unknown) and evaluating the impact on the model's vulnerability classifications using generalized linear mixed-effects models (GLMMs) and average marginal effects.
